editor.entity.name: Name
editor.object.position.hint: Relative to the parent object; for an object without a parent, in the world.
entity.body.height.hint: In blocks, for moving, finding paths, placing blocks and suffocating. Zero, with zero width, keeps the size of the entity type.
entity.body.mode.hint: What its box does to the entities it meets. Empty: they pass through each other. Pushing: they shove each other apart, the way mobs do. Blocking: it stops them and can be stood on, like a boat. When the model has pushing or solid colliders, the box takes no part in this: the colliders are met instead.
entity.body.pushable.hint: Players and mobs move it: a pushing body is shoved aside, a blocking one is pushed along by walking into it, like a crate. An empty body is never met. With colliders it is moved by leaning on a solid one and by standing in a pushing one, never by standing on it.
entity.body.width.hint: In blocks; the box is square. Zero, with zero height, keeps the size of the entity type.
entity.body.fit.hint: Width and height around the colliders of the model as it stands at rest. The width does not change as the entity turns.
entity.navigation.hint: How an engine NPC finds its way and what it may do on it. Without this component it goes by the defaults shown here; a script can change them for one move.
entity.navigation.straighten.hint: Walks the found path in straight lines wherever nothing is in the way, instead of block by block.
entity.navigation.dropDown.hint: Steps off ledges higher than a block, as high as the fall damage below allows, instead of looking for a way down. Water at the bottom takes any fall.
entity.navigation.fallDamage.hint: The fall damage, in half-hearts, the NPC takes for a shorter way. Zero falls only as far as is safe.
entity.navigation.jumpLevel.hint: Jumps over gaps onto ground as high as the ground it takes off from, instead of going around.
entity.navigation.jumpUp.hint: Jumps over gaps onto ground a block higher.
entity.navigation.jumpDown.hint: Jumps over gaps onto ground one or two blocks lower.
entity.navigation.maxGap.hint: In blocks. Whether the NPC clears a gap is worked out from its speed with the run-up and its jump strength, so a slow NPC may not jump the widest one.
entity.navigation.jumpCost.hint: How many blocks of walking a jump is worth: the NPC jumps when going around is longer by more than this. Also counts for jumping up a block.
entity.navigation.runUp.hint: How much faster than its own speed the NPC runs up to a jump over a gap.
entity.navigation.acceleration.hint: Seconds from standing to full speed.
entity.navigation.deceleration.hint: Seconds from full speed to a stop. The NPC brakes this early for the end of its path and for sharp turns.
entity.navigation.straightBoost.hint: How much faster the NPC walks on a long straight stretch. 1 never speeds up.
entity.navigation.straightLength.hint: In blocks: how long the straight stretch ahead has to be for the NPC to speed up. The extra speed fades out over the last half of it.
entity.navigation.backstep.hint: In blocks: the longest walk to a point behind the NPC it takes backward instead of turning round. Zero always turns.
entity.navigation.backwardSpeed.hint: The NPC's speed walking backward, as a share of walking forward.
entity.navigation.sidewaysSpeed.hint: The NPC's speed walking sideways, as a share of walking forward. It walks sideways while it faces something other than its path, and a little on small changes of course.
entity.navigation.swim.hint: Swims through deep water. Without it, water deeper than a block is a wall to the NPC; one that stands in it already gets out to the nearest shore.
entity.navigation.waterCost.hint: How many blocks of walking a block of water is worth, so a swimming NPC still takes a bridge.
entity.navigation.entities.hint: Steps out of the way of those standing on its path, coming toward it or crossing it: NPCs, players and mobs, all but those with an empty body. Meeting one head on, it keeps right, so two such NPCs pass each other; where there is no room to, one gives way and waits. It does not walk around whoever stands at the end of its path.
entity.navigation.blocks.hint: Blocks the NPC walks around: both the floor it stands on and the blocks its body is in count, such as farmland, a carpet or crops. For a block that matches several entries, the highest cost counts.
entity.navigation.block.hint: A block id such as minecraft:farmland, or a block tag such as #minecraft:flowers.
entity.navigation.cost.hint: How many blocks of walking stepping onto or into the block is worth. Negative: never; an NPC that stands on one already walks off it.
entity.colliders.overrides.hint: Changes made to the colliders of the model on this entity alone, by collider name. What is left unset stays as the rig has it. Scripts write these through entity.collider(name).
entity.colliders.enabled.hint: A disabled collider is not there at all: it is not hit, clicked or bumped into.
